SIKARAPID®-22 AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRapid®-22 AU, February 2024, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sikarapid-22-au.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRapid®-22 AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2024, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaRapid®-22 AU is a non chloride set and hardening accelerator for concrete, mortar and grout.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - SikaRapid®-22 AU is recommended for use in premix and precast concrete where fast setting and hardening time is required.
    - As a result, SikaRapid®-22 AU allows:
    - ▪ faster finishing of concrete surfaces
    - ▪ improved early strength of premixed concrete
    - ▪ faster slip-form production
    - ▪ used in ready mix concrete in cold climates
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRapid®-22 AU
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Setting and hardening accelerator for concrete mortar and grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. SikaRapid®-22 AU meets and exceeds all requirements of Australian Standard 1478.1-2000 for Accelerator (Ac).
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Faster setting time even at low temperatures
    - high early strength
    - increase the turnover of the formwork
    - reducing the time of steam curing cycles
    - no negative impact on the effectiveness of superplasticizers and other admixtures
    - no negative effect on the properties of concrete
    - SikaRapid®-22 AU does not contain chlorides or any other materials which promote the corrosion of steel reinforcement.Therefore It is suitable for reinforced and pre-stressed concrete.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Orange liquid
    - Density: 1.2 kg/l
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk delivery; 1000 litre IBC; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperatures between 5° C and 35° C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and from frost, shelf life is 12 months.
    - Storage conditions: Store SikaRapid®-22 AU at 5°/35°, protected from the direct sunlight

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2024, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2024, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Typical dosage range is 500ml - 2000ml/100 kg of total cementitious material. Exact dosage rate should be determined by site trials.
4.3 Dispensing. SikaRapid®-22 AU is added to batching water or is poured into the concrete mix at the same time as the gauging water. SikaRapid®-22 AU may also be added into the agitator truck on site. In this case, the concrete should then be mixed for an extra 1 minute for every cubic metre of concrete. The concrete should then be checked visually for uniform consistency before discharging. Do not add SikaRapid®-22 AU to dry mix.
4.4 Compatibility. SikaRapid®-22 AU can be used in conjunction with any non-retarded Sika Concrete admixtures. It is beneficial to add SikaRapid®-22 AU with the initial mixing. Tests must be carried out to determine the optimum batching sequence. Do not use SikaRapid®-22 AU in conjunction with shrinkage compensating admixtures (i.e expanding agents).
4.5 Limitations and important considerations. Where concrete with low cement content is being supplied, higher dosage rates should be used.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2024, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRapid®-22 AU, February 2024, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sikarapid-22-au.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaRapid®-22 AU, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-sikarapid-22au.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
